passed.description: True only when every applicable mandatory semantic, citation, provenance and stage-behavior requirement has been verified.

missing_facts.description: Material facts or required distinctions missing from the authoritative current report, each tied to an applicable criterion and output location when available.

incorrect_claims.description: Specific wrong, misleading or unsupported claims, broken/misleading citations, provenance loss or unjustified stage behavior, with actual output evidence.

feedback.description: Targeted, self-contained correction instructions suitable for a worker without hidden-rubric access; empty when no repair is needed.

limitations.description: Unverifiable aspects, evaluator access/tool limits, unresolved ambiguity and checks delegated to the harness; not a substitute for rejecting an unverified mandatory requirement.
